mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.level, pt.* FROM employee AS e JOIN ( SELECT team.department_id, parent.department_type, team.department_name FROM department team JOIN department parent ON team.parent_department_id = parent.department_id ) AS pt ON e.department_id = pt.department_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId};
SELECT a.employee_id FROM employee a JOIN (SELECT department_id FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}) AS w ON a.department_id = w.department_id WHERE a.`level` = 'lv5'

mapper.select: SELECT ea.approval_id, ea.writer_employee_id, ea.ea_type, ea.approval_status FROM electronic_approval ea INNER JOIN ea_proposal ep ON ep.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE ea.approval_id = #{approvalId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ea_proposal ( approval_id, proposal_title, proposal_content, proposal_purpose ) VALUES ( #{approvalId}, #{proposalTitle}, #{proposalContent}, #{proposalPurpose} )

INSERT INTO ea_business_trip ( approval_id, business_trip_executionDate, business_trip_location, business_trip_friend, business_trip_start, business_trip_end, business_trip_purpose, business_trip_content, business_trip_amount, business_trip_transportation, business_trip_title ) VALUES ( #{approvalId}, #{businessTripExecutionDate}, #{businessTripLocation}, #{businessTripFriend}, #{businessTripStart}, #{businessTripEnd}, #{businessTripPurpose}, #{businessTripContent}, #{businessTripAmount}, #{businessTripTransportation}, #{businessTripTitle} )

INSERT INTO ea_fact_report ( approval_id, fact_report_writeDate, fact_report_title, fact_report_occurrence, fact_report_location, fact_report_inspector, fact_report_cause, fact_report_countermeasures ) VALUES ( #{approvalId}, #{factReportWriteDate}, #{factReportTitle}, #{factReportOccurrence}, #{factReportLocation}, #{factReportInspector}, #{factReportCause}, #{factReportCountermeasures} )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'PENDING' AND writer_employee_id = #{employeeId} THEN 1 END) AS count_employee_pending, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVE' AND writer_employee_id = #{employeeId} THEN 1 END) AS count_employee_approve, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'REJECT' AND writer_employee_id = #{employeeId} THEN 1 END) AS count_employee_reject, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'PENDING' AND approver_employee_id = #{employeeId} THEN 1 END) AS count_approval_pending, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVE' AND approver_employee_id = #{employeeId} THEN 1 END) AS count_approval_approve, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'REJECT' AND approver_employee_id = #{employeeId} THEN 1 END) AS count_approval_reject FROM electronic_approval WHERE writer_employee_id = #{employeeId} OR approver_employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT ea.*, e.employee_name, approver.employee_name AS approver_name, COALESCE( proposal.proposal_title, request.approval_request_title, work.work_report_title, fact.fact_report_title, business.business_trip_title ) AS title FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = ea.writer_employee_id LEFT JOIN employee AS approver ON approver.employee_id = ea.approver_employee_id LEFT JOIN ea_proposal AS proposal ON proposal.approval_id = ea.approval_id LEFT JOIN ea_approval_request AS request ON request.approval_id = ea.approval_id LEFT JOIN ea_work_report AS work ON work.approval_id = ea.approval_id LEFT JOIN ea_fact_report AS fact ON fact.approval_id = ea.approval_id LEFT JOIN ea_business_trip AS business ON business.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE (ea.writer_employee_id = #{employeeId} OR ea.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId}) AND ea.approval_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVE', 'REJECT') ORDER BY ea.approval_write_at DESC, ea.approval_id DESC

choose.when: SELECT ea.*, ep.*, writer.employee_name AS employee_name, approver.employee_name AS approver_name FROM electronic_approval AS ea LEFT JOIN ea_proposal AS ep ON ea.approval_id = ep.approval_id LEFT JOIN employee AS writer ON writer.employee_id = ea.writer_employee_id LEFT JOIN employee AS approver ON approver.employee_id = ea.approver_employee_id WHERE ea.ea_type = 'PROPOSAL' AND (ea.writer_employee_id = #{employeeId} OR ea.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId}) AND ea.approval_id = #{approvalId}

SELECT ea.*, ear.*, e.employee_name, ae.employee_name AS approver_name FROM electronic_approval AS ea LEFT JOIN ea_approval_request AS ear ON ea.approval_id = ear.approval_id LEFT JOIN employee AS e ON ea.writer_employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee AS ae ON ea.approver_employee_id = ae.employee_id WHERE (ea.writer_employee_id = #{employeeId} OR ea.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId}) AND ea.approval_id = #{approvalId}
